integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.title: loss of containment at G-8102 during commissioning of replacement equipment

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on G-8102 and TT-8102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on G-8102 and TT-8102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. G-8102 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 1 December 2020 an incident occurred on G-8102 and TT-8102 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
